table.name: TLGNC_DB_VERSION_LOG
table.description: Log table to track initial installation and subsequent patch installations.

column.name: DB_VERSION_LOG_ID
column.description: PK. Unique ID of the log entry.

column.name: VERSION
column.description: Version number of the LOGON release

column.name: INSTALL_START_TS
column.description: Start timestamp of the installation or patch

column.name: INSTALL_END_TS
column.description: End timestamp of the installation or patch

column.name: INSTALL_TYPE
column.description: 'initial' for installation from scratch (should appear only once), or 'patch'

column.name: CLIENT_IP
column.description: Client IP that runs the (patch) script
